matched.extracted: Add product to cart. The system shall allow a user to add a product to their cart from the product page.
Item quantity limits. The system shall allow the quantity of each cart item to be set to a whole number from 1 to 10.
Remove items from cart. The system shall allow a user to remove an item from their cart.
Persistent cart for logged-in users. The system shall keep a logged-in user's cart contents across sessions, so items remain in the cart after the user logs out and back in.
Guest checkout. The system shall allow a user to complete checkout as a guest, without creating an account.
Address validation. The system shall validate the shipping address against the postal service's address database.
Save validated address to address book. The system shall save the validated address to the user's address book.
Short checkout. The checkout should not take too many steps.
Order summary display. Before payment, the system shall show an order summary listing each item, the subtotal, the delivery fee, and the order total.
Card payment processing. The system shall process credit and debit card payments through a PCI-compliant third-party payment processor.
Declined payment handling. If a payment is declined, the system shall show the decline reason returned by the payment processor.
Fast payment processing. Payment processing should be fast.
Free delivery threshold. The system shall charge no delivery fee for orders with a subtotal of €50.00 or more, and a flat delivery fee of €4.95 for orders below €50.00.
Estimated delivery date display. The system shall display an estimated delivery date based on the shipping method the user selects.
Order confirmation email. The system shall send an order confirmation email with an itemized receipt within 5 minutes of a successful payment.
Smooth Checkout Experience. The checkout experience shall be smooth and intuitive.
Email and password login. The system shall allow a registered user to log in using their email address and password.
Account lockout after failed login attempts. The system shall lock a user's account for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window.
Locked-account message. When an account is locked, the system shall show a message stating that the account is temporarily locked and the time at which the user may try again.
Generic login error message. The system shall display a generic "invalid email or password" error message when login fails, without indicating whether the email address or the password was incorrect.
Remember me functionality. The system shall offer a "Remember me" option that keeps the user logged in on that device for 30 days.
Required registration fields. The system shall require a valid email address, a password, and the user's full name to create a new account.
Email verification for new accounts. The system shall keep a new account unverified until the user clicks the confirmation link in the verification email sent to the address provided at registration.

Duplicate email prevention. The system shall reject a registration that uses an email address already associated with an existing account, and direct the user to log in or reset their password instead.
Easy registration. Registration should be quick and easy for new users.
Password complexity. The system shall require new passwords to be at least 12 characters long and to contain at least one digit and one symbol.
Password reset link generation. The system shall send a password reset link to the user's registered email address on request.
Session invalidation on password change. The system shall end all of the user's other active sessions when the password is changed.
Reset link expiry. A password reset link shall expire 24 hours after it is sent.
Password reuse prevention. The system shall prevent a user from reusing any of their 3 most recent passwords.
Two-factor authentication. The system shall allow a user to enable two-factor authentication (2FA) using a time-based one-time password (TOTP) authenticator app.
Protection against common attacks. The system should be secure against common attacks.
Login audit log recording. The system shall record every successful and failed login attempt in an audit log with the timestamp, the email address used, and the source IP address.
Session timeout on inactivity. User sessions should time out after a reasonable period of inactivity.
